g.text: Why does the coupon save10 fail?
Why does the coupon save10 fail?
normalize keeps the case, so save10 never matches SAVE10.
Set the model new sessions of this project start with
Sonnet reads this session's conversation again on its next turn:
the first turn is slower and costs more.
normalize keeps the case, so save10 never matches SAVE10.
Is there a test for lower case codes?
No. test/coupon.test.mjs only checks upper case codes.
Opus answered. You type /model to see the models.
You pick sonnet. The session's model changes.
Your next message goes to Sonnet.
The reply comes from Sonnet, in the same chat.
/agent change sets the effort of a model too.
From its next turn Sonnet works at high effort.
